args.summary: Since the latest deploy, checkout-api (v2.3.1) was frequently failing health checks (18% error rate) across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). SRE rolled the service back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed in all regions and was verified via health checks: service is now healthy with a 0.2% error rate. Follow-up needed to investigate the regression in v2.3.1 before attempting a redeploy.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks - rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 and failing health checks with an 18% error rate across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Per the deployment history, v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions, then verified — the service is now healthy with a 0.2% error rate.
3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks - rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure, the rollback, and the verification results. The on-call engineer has been paged.

The incident notes that follow-up investigation is needed into the v2.3.1 regression before attempting a redeploy.
